title: US State Privacy Laws Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request data access, deletion, or opt-out under Texas, Virginia, Colorado, and other US state privacy laws. Easy customizable format.
description: Exercise your privacy rights under US state laws like Texas DPA, Virginia CDPA, and Colorado CPA. This template helps you request data access, deletion, or sale opt-outs from businesses in a compliant format that companies must legally respond to.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Name]

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Rights Request Under [State] Privacy Law

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights under the [State Privacy Law Name] as a resident of [State]. This request pertains to the personal information you have collected, processed, or sold about me.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity, I am providing the following information:

• Full Name: [Your Name]
• Email Address: [Your Email]
• Account Number/Username (if applicable): [Account Info]
• Additional verification information: [Any other relevant details]

I understand you may need additional information to verify my identity and am willing to provide reasonable verification as required by law.

sections.heading: Specific Rights Request
sections.content:
I hereby request the following under my state privacy rights:

☐ RIGHT TO KNOW: Provide me with information about what personal data you have collected about me, including:
   • Categories of personal information collected
   • Sources of the personal information
   • Business purposes for collecting the information
   • Categories of third parties with whom you share personal information

☐ RIGHT TO ACCESS: Provide me with a copy of the specific pieces of personal information you have collected about me.

☐ RIGHT TO DELETE: Delete all personal information you have collected about me, subject to legal exceptions.

☐ RIGHT TO OPT-OUT: Stop selling or sharing my personal information for targeted advertising purposes.

☐ RIGHT TO CORRECT: Correct any inaccurate personal information you maintain about me.

sections.heading: Legal Requirements and Timeline
sections.content:
Please note that under [State Privacy Law], you are required to:

• Respond to this request within 45 days (with possible 45-day extension)
• Provide information free of charge
• Not discriminate against me for exercising these rights
• Verify my identity using reasonable means

If you cannot comply with this request, please explain the specific legal basis for your inability to do so.

sections.heading: Preferred Response Method
sections.content:
Please provide your response via:
☐ Email to: [Your Email Address]
☐ Mail to the address listed above
☐ Secure online portal (please provide access instructions)

If you maintain an online account for me, I would prefer to receive this information through a secure, password-protected portal.

sections.heading: Closing and Contact Information
sections.content:
I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions about this request or need additional information to verify my identity, please contact me at [Your Phone Number] or [Your Email Address].

I expect a response within the timeframe required by law. Thank you for your cooperation in helping me exercise my privacy rights.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

useCases: Requesting data deletion from companies under Texas Data Privacy and Security Act
Accessing personal information collected by businesses under Virginia CDPA
Opting out of data sales under Colorado Privacy Act

Requesting data portability from companies in states with comprehensive privacy laws
Correcting inaccurate personal information held by businesses
Following up on ignored privacy requests with formal documentation
